# Fakerer v1.2.1 - Table of Contents

> A maintained fork of Faker. A pure Elixir library for generating fake data.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [Fakerer](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Faker](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.md): Main module to start application with some helper functions.

- [Faker.Address](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.md): Functions for generating addresses.

- [Faker.Address.Da](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.Da.md): Functions for generating addresses in Danish

- [Faker.Address.En](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.En.md): Functions for generating addresses in English

- [Faker.Address.Es](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.Es.md): Functions for generating addresses in Spanish

- [Faker.Address.Hy](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.Hy.md): Functions for generating addresses in Armenian

- [Faker.Address.It](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.It.md): Functions for generating addresses in Italian

- [Faker.Address.PtBr](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.PtBr.md): Functions for generating addresses in Portuguese

- [Faker.Address.Ru](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Address.Ru.md): Functions for generating addresses in Russian

- [Faker.Airports](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Airports.md): Functions for generating airports related data

- [Faker.Airports.En](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Airports.En.md): Functions for generating airports related data in English

- [Faker.Airports.PtBr](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Airports.PtBr.md): Functions for generating airports related data in Portuguese

- [Faker.App](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.App.md): Functions for generating app specific properties.

- [Faker.Avatar](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Avatar.md): Functions for generate random urls for avatars.

- [Faker.Aws.En](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Aws.En.md): Functions for generating AWS information in English

- [Faker.Name](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Name.md): Deprecated. Faker.Name will be removed in 1.0.0. Please use Faker.Person instead.

- [Faker.Person](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Person.md): Functions for generating names for a person.

[Telephone numbers in the United Kingdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Telephone_numbers_in_the_United_Kingdom).

at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/North_American_Numbering_Plan.
- [Faker.Phone.Hy](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Phone.Hy.md): Functions for generating phone related data in Armenian

- [Faker.Phone.PtBr](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Phone.PtBr.md): Function to generate Brazilian phone numbers.

- [Faker.Phone.PtPt](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Phone.PtPt.md): Functions for generating phone related data for portugal location

- [Faker.Pizza](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Pizza.md): Functions for generating Pizza related data in English.

- [Faker.Random.Elixir](https://fakerer.hexdocs.pm/Faker.Random.Elixir.md): Default implementation of random functions based on erlang and elixir standard library.
